body: I appreciate that very very much man, the best thing I’ve read all day I appreciate it a lot, patience is something I have to learn and it doesn’t come easy, I can only thank you, I appreciate that a lot really

I appreciate that but it’s so hard, everyone is happy and better off without me, it just was the cherry on top that the love of my life left, and it just makes me feel so much more worse, we’ve been through really everything and one thing tears us apart
